description: This file defines a composable function ChatMarkdown that renders Markdown formatted text (supporting headings, code blocks, images, lists, tables, and more) into a Compose UI layout. It uses the org.commonmark library for Markdown parsing and includes functions to render various Markdown elements with custom styles.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class holding style information for inline Markdown elements such as code, links, and base callout style.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row in a rendered Markdown table, indicating if it's a header row and containing cell data.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class representing an inline image embedded as base64 data with MIME type.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable that takes Markdown text and renders it with styling, supporting nested block elements recursively.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Private composable that iterates over Markdown nodes and renders each block element appropriately.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a paragraph node, either as an image if it contains a standalone base64 image or as styled text.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders a bullet (unordered) list with proper indentation and list items.

methods.name: RenderOrderedList
methods.description: Renders an ordered list with numbered items.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items including task list markers if applicable.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Displays a Markdown table with scrollable capability for wide tables.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Helper that constructs table rows from table node structures for rendering.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads either header or body sections of a table to build row data.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads individual table row node and extracts cell data.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds an AnnotatedString from the first child node of Markdown content, applying styles.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Recursively appends styled inline elements (text, code, emphasis, links, images, etc.) to an AnnotatedString builder.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Converts a Markdown node subtree into plain text.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Checks if a paragraph node contains a standalone base64 image and returns its details.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses a data URI for embedded images and retrieves MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Determines text style for headings based on their level.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Composable that renders an image from a base64 string, or fallback if loading fails.
